child.label: Reasons for Actions
child.description: Questions asking why a person in a short everyday scene did what they did: the goal or reason behind their action.
child.not_for: What the person had to do beforehand (use Steps Needed Beforehand); what they or others will want to do or what will happen next (use What Happens Next). How someone feels or what they are like (use Reading Feelings & Character).
examples: Why did Sydney do this? (Sydney packed their lunch.)
Why did Taylor do this? (Taylor pushed Sasha's hair out of her face before pictures.)
Why did Kai pull a prank on Jan?

child.label: Steps Needed Beforehand
child.description: Questions asking what a person in a short everyday scene needed to do, have, or know before the action described could happen.
child.not_for: Why the person did it (use Reasons for Actions); what they or others will do or what will happen afterwards (use What Happens Next).
examples: What does Sasha need to do before this? (Sasha studied all night and made an A.)
What does Kendall need to do before this? (Kendall spent money on a new purse.)
What does Remy need to do before this? (Remy posted flyers looking for a dog.)

child.label: What Happens Next
child.description: Questions asking what a person or others in a short everyday scene will want to do next, or what will happen to them as a result.
child.not_for: Why the person did it (use Reasons for Actions); what they had to do beforehand (use Steps Needed Beforehand); how they will feel (use Reading Feelings & Character).
examples: What will Austin want to do next? (Austin sat on the couch to watch a movie.)
What will happen to Jesse? (Jesse was stuck with a hospital bill.)
What will others want to do next?

samples:
In `context`, what will others want to do next?
Trade in their shares / Decide to keep their shares in the market / support others to also sell their shares
